name: Hologram Model Hub
description: One endpoint for open models: find one, fetch it from a source that is up, and prove the bytes.

skills.name: Discovery
skills.description: What this endpoint is, in a form a machine can bind to without reading prose.

skills.name: Health
skills.description: Is the endpoint up, and which byte sources are up behind it.

skills.name: Models
skills.description: Find a model and read its files, in Hugging Face's shape. This is the dialect every Python client already speaks.

skills.name: Files
skills.description: Turn a model file into a URL that is up right now, together with the SHA-256 it must have.

skills.name: Objects
skills.description: The content-addressed floor under every dialect. An object is named by the BLAKE3 of its bytes, so its answer can be cached forever.

skills.name: Registry
skills.description: The OCI distribution dialect: Ollama pulls, CNCF ModelPack artifacts, and the hub's own daily index. Reads are anonymous; a write is refused at the edge unless it carries the registry token that `docker login` sends, and writes are not described here because only the hub publishes.

skills.name: Account
skills.description: The only surface that needs a person. Everything else on this endpoint is anonymous, and signing in adds nothing to it: an account exists so that a saved list, an attributed model request and a recorded interest in publishing have somewhere to live. Signing in grants no read that anonymous callers do not already have, and publishing access is an operator's decision, not a form's.

skills.name: MCP
skills.description: The Model Context Protocol server, for agents that bind to tools rather than to routes.
